title: H¹ along a unit-speed line is Lebesgue measure (change of variables)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, a, τ ∈ ℝ^P with |τ| = 1, and φ(u) := a + uτ for u ∈ ℝ. For every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ: (i) φ(A) is a Borel subset of ℝ^P; (ii) H¹(φ(A)) = L¹(A); (iii) ∫_{φ(A)} h dH¹ = ∫_A h(a + uτ) du for every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ. Here H¹ is Mathlib's normalized Euclidean Hausdorff measure μHE[1] on ℝ^P (= EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)), L¹ is volume on ℝ, and the integrals are Bochner integrals (value 0 when not integrable).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a τ : Euclid P), ‖τ‖ = 1 → ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet ((fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A) ∧ μHE[1] ((fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A) = volume A ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x in (fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A, h x ∂μHE[1] = ∫ u in A, h (a + u • τ)
